newsitem.title: CHINA: Earthquake jolts China's eastern Fujian.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake jolts China's eastern Fujian.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.2 on the open-ended Richter scale has jolted China's eastern Fujian province, damaging some buildings, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.

The tremor struck between Yong'an city and Liancheng county at 2.51 p.m. (0651 GMT) and was felt throughout the entire province and in parts of neighbouring provinces of Jiangxi and Guangdong, Xinhua said.
There were no immediate reports of injuries but provincial seismological officials rushed to the site to investigate the situation, the agency said.
"It has caused damage to some buildings in Liancheng and Yong'an," the agency said.
The quake's epicentre was located at 25.6 degrees north and 117.0 degrees east, it quoted the State Seismological Bureau as saying.

Earlier, Xinhua said an earthquake measuring 5.3 on the Richter scale had rocked a remote and sparsely populated area in the northwestern region of Xinjiang on Saturday, but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
